title: PCR/qPCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: A fresh tip is picked up.
Tips are deposited in the trash (slot 12)

steps.title: Set up plates and reagents
steps.instruction: Place three 96‑well deep‑well plates in slots 7, 8, and 9. Load SPR Wash Buffer plate in slot 4, VHB Buffer plate in slot 5, and Nuclease‑Free Water plate in slot 6. Choose the P300‑Multi pipette mount side (left or right) as desired.

steps.title: Aliquot SPR Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Using an 8‑channel P300‑Multi pipette, transfer a total of 350 µL SPR Wash Buffer from slot 4 to each well of the deep‑well plate in slot 7. Perform two aspirate/dispense moves of 175 µL per column, covering columns 1 through 11. Use a fresh tip for the entire plate and discard the tip in the trash (slot 12).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 175 µL and dispense into column 1‑11 (first movement)
Aspirate another 175 µL and dispense into column 1‑11 (second movement)

steps.title: Aliquot VHB Buffer
steps.instruction: Using an 8‑channel P300‑Multi pipette, transfer a total of 350 µL VHB Buffer from slot 5 to each well of the deep‑well plate in slot 8. Perform two aspirate/dispense moves of 175 µL per column, covering columns 1 through 11. Use a fresh tip for the entire plate and discard the tip in the trash (slot 12).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 175 µL and dispense into column 1‑11 (first movement)
Aspirate another 175 µL and dispense into column 1‑11 (second movement)

steps.title: Aliquot Nuclease‑Free Water
steps.instruction: Using an 8‑channel P300‑Multi pipette, transfer 50 µL Nuclease‑Free Water from slot 6 to each well of the deep‑well plate in slot 9 in a single movement per column, covering columns 1 through 11. Use a fresh tip for the entire plate and discard the tip in the trash (slot 12).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 50 µL and dispense into column 1‑11 (single movement)
